title: Botpress Alternatives: Best Options Compared (2026)
summary: Botpress alternatives include chatbot platforms and automation tools. Compare features and pricing to pick the right option for your business needs.
body_markdown:
## Where Activepieces fits among Botpress alternatives


The comparison above sorts platforms by whether the job is conversation or action.


**Activepieces belongs only in the action half** , where its 741 integrations and MIT-licensed core are the draw, and it is not a like-for-like chatbot replacement for Botpress, so don't consider it if you need a chatbot.


### What the AI agent step can act in


In Activepieces, automations are built as flows, and an AI agent is one step in a flow. That step can use the same integrations the rest of the flow does.


These integrations are called pieces, there are 741 of them counted from the open source monorepo, roughly 60% are community-contributed, and the full list is at[activepieces.com/pieces](https://www.activepieces.com/pieces) .


In practice, the agent can read a customer record in your CRM (the system where sales contacts and deals live) and draft a reply. It then hands off to the ordinary steps that update the record or send the email.


That matters because the agent isn't a separate thing bolted onto your tools. It sits in the same flow as your CRM, your email, and your spreadsheets, so you can see each step it took and fix the one that went wrong.


### Approval and self-hosting


Before anything changes, a flow can pause at an approval step until a person clicks approve. Only then does it continue to the steps that change something.


If you skip this, you are trusting the agent's draft to be right every time, and the one time it isn't, a wrong email is already in a customer's inbox.


The CRM update and the email send then happen, all inside a box labelled self-hosted.


Take from it that the person's click sits before every action that touches the outside world, and that the whole run stays on infrastructure you control.


With self-hosting, your customer data and your credentials never leave your own servers, and the core is MIT-licensed.


If you'd rather not run servers, there is a hosted version too, and its free plan costs $0 with 1,000 credits a month, unlimited flows and up to 5 users; you can try it at[cloud.activepieces.com/sign-up](https://cloud.activepieces.com/sign-up?ap_cta=blog_body&ref=%2Fblog%2Fbotpress-alternatives-best-options-compared-2026) .


### What it does not replace


If your main need is a support bot living on a website, WhatsApp, or Messenger, with conversation design, handoff to a live agent, and a chat window to embed, Botpress was built for that.


Activepieces is not a chat-channel builder and won't replace it. Its 741 integrations reach your business apps, not a chat window, so you would be rebuilding the conversation layer yourself.


The next section turns that split into a plain test you can run against your own list of jobs.
